name: IMZenX
description: Use IM and ZenX with the same local Agent and Thread.
mainDocument: IMZenX is an ordinary plugin available to any Agent. Read status, then readiness to inspect only explicitly selected own IMZen configuration and declared credential files with the selected Python runtime; it never launches IM or searches another app or legacy files. Prepare saves only nonsecret path/settings and disables automatic connection until explicit Connect. Prepare does not restart a running consumer; status distinguishes saved and active configuration. Before connecting a prepared configuration, obtain the user/coordinator acknowledgement that other consumers of this bot are stopped and set singleConsumerConfirmed=true. This acknowledgement is not a delivery test. Normal plugin permissions and Host confirmation policy apply; these tools grant no other plugins or PAWs permission. Never put credentials in tool arguments, results or logs. Missing private SDK requires user-controlled trusted setup, not automatic installation. Connected means the SDK Gateway started, not verified bot delivery. IMZenX connects explicitly configured IM channels to this ZenX Host. Use status to inspect it. Configure only with user-supplied private channel configuration and a Python executable with the pinned SDK. In IM, /threads lists titles and numbers; /pick <number> selects one shared Thread and receives its replies in this conversation. Numbers refer to this conversation's last displayed list; refresh replaces it and after restart run /threads again. /new clears selection; the next ordinary message starts a new Thread. /subscribe and /unsubscribe remain select/clear aliases. Desktop replies on a subscribed Thread are delivered to IM. Never put bot credentials in tool arguments. PAW mode: /paws lists assistant Rooms in the configured workspace; /paw selects one. Only explicit Room agent posts return to IM, keeping direct working Thread output separate. /new clears PAW selection. Text only; platform-native receipts, quotes and reactions are not mapped.
